$comment: VAPP-91: the wire decoders (catalog/host.json transport). Inputs hand-written; `expected` filled by `bun run --filter @exponential_app/eui generate` from the TS reference (src/host/decoders.ts). `mcpAction` cases carry `metadata` (round 9 §1.3) when the surface has sendDataModel. Every renderer's conformance runner replays it: feed `chunks` in order through ONE decoder, then end(). #AXC-12 (catalog/host.json `inference`): `express` = feed `chunks` through ONE ExpressDecoder({wrapped, surfaceId}) then end(); `expressSse` = ONE SseDecoder({surfaceId}) (its `a2ui-express` events are one Express response, JSON events beside them); `expressWs` = ONE FrameDecoder({surfaceId}), one push per frame, then end(); `expressMcp` = messagesFromMcpResult(result, {surfaceId}); `expressContentTypes` = inferenceFormatOf(contentType); `expressCapabilities` = rendererCapabilities(extensionIds, {inferenceFormats}). Messages, issues and `text` (absent = none) equal `expected`; a missing surfaceId = the contract default (`main`). Expected values come from the TS reference over the vendored wasm.
